punchline: Nine kings rode behind one coffin, and it was the last time.
thirty_sec: At Edward VII's funeral in London on 20 May 1910, nine reigning monarchs rode behind the coffin; Tuchman calls it the greatest assemblage of royalty ever gathered and the last of its kind, and within years several of those thrones were gone.
question: What quiet sign of strain could you check behind the most impressive thing you rely on?
key_contrast: The display was at its peak while the strain was already there.
